subject: PO advance window, invoice waterfall, and EFT mapping for FYQ4 commitment
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsphere.com>, HealthSphere Procurement <procurement@healthsphere.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: PO advance window, invoice waterfall, and EFT mapping for FYQ4 commitment

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a lightweight PO template that shows two possible invoice waterfalls so your procurement team can see how we’d map the $500k commitment across fiscal periods. High-level options: 

- Option A: Split by fiscal close — $350,000 invoiced in FYQ4, $150,000 invoiced at start of FYQ1 (two invoices).
- Option B: Milestone ladder — three invoices tied to go-live, 30/40/30 split (helps match your budget lanes).

We can accept an advance/prepay to lock the FYQ4 pricing band; typically we offer a 6–8% prepay discount if 25–35% is remitted within 15 days of PO acknowledgement. If HealthSphere needs the net terms stretched, we can propose a stepped net schedule (e.g., net30 on first tranche, net45 on remainder) to meet audit windows while protecting Redwood’s cashflow.

Can you confirm: 
1) Which option (A/B/alternate) maps to your FY cutover?
2) Will procurement provide an official PO number that we can reference on invoices (and a preferred invoice-to contact)?
3) Do you require a specific remit address/lockbox wording or an ACH form?

Attached: PO_Template_HealthSphere.pdf (stub) — this is editable so legal/finance can add required clauses. I’m looping in Ben (billing) to confirm the ACH path and Marissa for prepay processing. Karthik is on standby for any PO redlines.

Next step: if you send the procurement form back with preferred option and PO #, Ben will send an ACH stub and we’ll return an invoice schedule for signature/DocuSign.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_Template_HealthSphere.pdf (PDF)]
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsphere.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSphere Procurement <procurement@healthsphere.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO advance window, invoice waterfall, and EFT mapping for FYQ4 commitment

Tessa —

Thanks for the template. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- HealthSphere prefers Option A (split by fiscal close) — we need the $350k in FYQ4 and remainder in FYQ1 so it matches our budget.
- Net terms: procurement will push for net90 across both invoices. Can Redwood do net90? If not, is there a middle ground (net45 or staged net)?
- Remit & EFT: we require supplier bank details + completed ACH vendor form (I attached our procurement form). Also, our PO number must be present on each invoice and the PO must reference the Master Services Agreement (MSA) we signed earlier (Ref: MSA-2025-09).

I attached HealthSphere_Procurement_Form.xlsx with required fields. Two asks for you/Redwood: 1) Confirm bank details + W-9 (or equivalent) and 2) Provide the contract wording we need to include on the PO referencing the MSA and Redwood’s tax ID/remit address.

We’ll issue PO HS-PO-8345 once vendor details and acceptance of split cadence are confirmed.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager — HealthSphere
[Attachment: HealthSphere_Procurement_Form.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsphere.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO advance window, invoice waterfall, and EFT mapping for FYQ4 commitment

Alicia —

Appreciate the quick reply and the procurement form. Short answers: 

- Net terms: Redwood cannot accept blanket net90 on annual commitments without mitigation. Proposed compromise: net45 on the FYQ4 invoice and net90 on the FYQ1 tranche for this first year only; alternatively, we’ll accept net60 across both tranches with a contractual acknowledgement on the PO that the second tranche is contingent on the FYQ1 appropriation. Which do you prefer?

- Prepay option: we can offer a 7% prepay discount if HealthSphere remits 30% of the total within 15 days of PO acknowledgement (this secures the FYQ4 pricing band). If you take prepay, we’ll issue a credit memorandum applied to the FYQ4 invoice.

- Remit/EFT: Ben, can you confirm draft ACH instructions for Alicia? Karthik, can you provide the standard redline we expect on PO language so Alicia can drop it into HS_Procurement_Form?

If HealthSphere is comfortable with net45/net90 split, we’ll draft the invoice schedule and DocuSign package referencing HS-PO-8345 and MSA-2025-09. If you want to proceed with the prepay, we’ll include the credit terms in the DocuSign.

Action items: 
- Alicia: confirm net45/net90 or net60 option, and whether you’ll elect the 7% prepay discount.
- Ben: attach ACH stub + W-9 (redwood).
- Karthik: send PO clause language snippet for procurement.

Thanks — will keep this moving once we have answers.

Best,
Tessa
[Quoted text removed]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Alicia / Tessa —

We can support the split invoices and the prepay flow described. Attached is a stub of Redwood_ACH_Instructions.xlsx and our W-9. For the ACH we ask that procurement returns the completed ACH vendor form (from your attachment) with the HealthSphere remit contact and the lockbox/GL mapping if you have one.

Bank stub attached: Redwood_ACH_Instructions.xlsx (will provide full bank docs once we have your completed ACH form).

If you elect prepay, finance will accept 30% up-front and apply credit to the FYQ4 invoice as discussed. Please confirm who on your side will be listed as the invoice recipient and the email to send invoices to for AP.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_ACH_Instructions.xlsx (XLSX); Attachment: Redwood_W-9.pdf (PDF)]
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsphere.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, HealthSphere Procurement <procurement@healthsphere.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO advance window, invoice waterfall, and EFT mapping for FYQ4 commitment

Team —

We’ll proceed with Option A (350k in FYQ4 / 150k FYQ1). Procurement is willing to approve net45 on the FYQ4 tranche and net90 on the FYQ1 tranche (your split compromise). HealthSphere will not take the prepay discount this cycle — budget prefers invoice timing.

Next steps from our side: procurement will issue PO HS-PO-8345 once Redwood confirms the following three items: 
1) Final invoice schedule for the two tranches (invoice dates and net due dates)
2) ACH/wiring remit instructions and Redwood tax ID (W-9) — Ben please confirm these are final
3) The PO text to reference MSA-2025-09 and the HS vendor form field names for GL mapping (we need the exact clause to paste into our PO)

I attached our completed procurement form with the GL codes filled out for the FYQ4 tranche. Once we receive the schedule and bank details we’ll issue HS-PO-8345 and route for signature. Please include the DocuSign link for our CPO to sign.

Thanks,
Alicia
Senior Procurement Manager — HealthSphere
[Attachment: HealthSphere_Procurement_Form_Filled.xlsx (XLSX)]
